aa_api.fetch: GET with x-api-key (AA_API_KEY); evaluations.artificial_analysis_{intelligence,coding}_index, terminalbench_v2_1 (fraction, stored x100), pricing fallback
aa_api.name: aa_api

aa_free.fetch: GET ?page=N with x-api-key header until pagination.has_more is false; AAI, index cost, domain indexes, pricing; effort from slug or name
aa_free.name: aa_free

aa_omniscience.fetch: one GET; embedded omniscience and hallucinationRate (stored as factuality)
aa_omniscience.name: aa_omniscience

aa_page_3d.fetch: one GET; aa3dElo plus its 95% interval, board aa_3d
aa_page_3d.name: aa_page_3d

aa_page_cyber.fetch: one GET; embedded cyberIndex (aa_cyber) per model record
aa_page_cyber.name: aa_page_cyber

aa_page_healthbench.fetch: one GET; embedded healthbench per model record
aa_page_healthbench.name: aa_page_healthbench

aa_page_lcr.fetch: one GET; embedded fields terminalBench40 (tb4) and lcr per model record
aa_page_lcr.name: aa_page_lcr

arena_european_mean.fetch: mean of French, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian Arena boards
arena_european_mean.name: arena_european_mean

arena_lang_mean.fetch: mean of the cached Arena language boards (at least 5 present)
arena_lang_mean.name: arena_lang_mean

claude_roster.fetch: candidates: old roster + additionalModelOptionsCache + overrides.*.probe; truth: claude -p probe
claude_roster.name: Claude Code deployment roster

deep_swe.fetch: GET; server-rendered table (model, Pass@1 percent); all rows mini-swe-agent
deep_swe.name: deep_swe

eq_bench.fetch: GET; strip 'const EQBENCH4_DATA = ' and trailing ';'; .models[] {model, elo}
eq_bench.name: eq_bench

openrouter.fetch: GET; .data[].pricing USD per token x1e6; negative = alias sentinel, skipped
openrouter.name: openrouter

openrouter_key.fetch: local read; openrouter.models[].cost input/output, the price this key pays
openrouter_key.name: openrouter_key

pi_roster.fetch: enabledModels[] intersected with openrouter.models[].id (pi-zdr); enabledModels alone (pi-enabled)
pi_roster.name: Pi enabledModels and models-store
